subject: DR test schedule, RTO/RPO matrix & SLA exception follow-up
messages:
From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@stellarisbank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@stellarisbank.com, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@stellarisbank.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: DR rehearsal window & RTO/RPO clarification

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the overview yesterday. We've been asked by our continuity team to lock in a 2-week window for a joint DR rehearsal that tests: multi-region switchover, KV cache population/consistency, and verification of recovery time for active sessions. High level asks:
- Can Redwood commit to an RTO of <= 5 minutes for read-only traffic and <= 20 minutes for full read/write session switch?
- What is your achievable RPO for embeddings and conversational state for our (30k daily session) workload?
- We also need to understand what operational support you provide during the exercise and whether a temporary SLA exception is required to run the full-scale rehearsal.

We can offer a testing window between Oct 4–15. Please attach your test plan and any matrices you want us to review.

Best,
Laura
Director, Resilience & Ops
Stellaris Bank

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@stellarisbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DR rehearsal window & RTO/RPO clarification

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a focused rehearsal plan and a concise RTO/RPO matrix for the Stellaris profile (see attachments). Quick summary up front: 

- RTO (read-only): target <= 3 minutes in our multi-region config when failing over within the same cloud provider and using warmed KV caches.
- RTO (full read/write): end-to-end validation target <= 18 minutes when executing our standard switchover with cache warm-up + schema checks.
- RPO (embeddings/conversation state): typically <= 30s for in-flight tokens with streaming replication; up to 5 minutes for lower-priority batch embeddings depending on your chosen durability tier.

Operational support during the rehearsal: a dedicated Red team member + SRE on call, a shared Slack channel, and runbook-driven play-by-play. For the full-scale rehearsal you outlined (30k daily sessions), we recommend a short SLA exception to allow temporary deviation from autoscaling limits and to permit targeted throttling for verification tasks — we've prepared a draft SLA Exception Request Form (attached) you can review.

Proposed rehearsal schedule (we can refine):
1) Oct 6 — prep call, confirm test account + load profile.
2) Oct 8 — dry run (non-production) to validate orchestration steps.
3) Oct 12 — full rehearsal in a controlled window (2.5 hours).
4) Oct 14 — observed post-mortem and evidence handoff.

I've attached: DR_Test_Plan_v2.pdf (detailed playbook), RTO_RPO_matrix.xlsx (values under different durability/quantization profiles), SLA_Exception_Request_Form.pdf (pre-filled draft).

Can you confirm Oct 12 as the primary rehearsal date? If you want, Ben will own customer ops coordination and Sean will escalate SLA approval internally.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DR_Test_Plan_v2.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: RTO_RPO_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: SLA_Exception_Request_Form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DR rehearsal window & RTO/RPO clarification

Ava / Sean — leaving notes here for internal coordination before I reply with a finalized schedule to Laura.
- Capacity: for the 30k session profile we should reserve an extra 2 dedicated GPU nodes for the rehearsal window to avoid noisy-neighbor effects. That will be a temporary commit (2–4 hours).
- Cost: estimate ~ $2.4k for the extra reserved capacity and SRE support. I'll include that in the operational note.
- SLA Exception: I'll attach the customer-facing explanation of why an exception is requested; Sean, can you sign off on the exception parameters (timebox, scope, rollback)?

If I don't hear back by EOD I will propose Oct 12 and include the exception as a short-term signed addendum.

—Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DR rehearsal window & RTO/RPO clarification

Ben — approved in principle. Conditions for SLA exception approval:
- Exception window must be strictly timeboxed to the rehearsal (max 3 hours live impact).
- Pre-rehearsal checklist completed (runbook signoff, fallback plan, verified roll-back checkpoint).
- Finance informed; we will attempt to absorb cost under trial support for strategic accounts but accept that we may bill if consumption materially exceeds the estimate.

I'll sign the SLA_Exception_Request_Form once you add the timebox and fallback checkpoint details. Please copy legal when ready (I'll loop them in if needed).

—Sean
VP, Customer Success

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@stellarisbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, ops@stellarisbank.com, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@stellarisbank.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DR rehearsal window & RTO/RPO clarification

Hi Laura — quick update and formal proposal:

We can confirm Oct 12 as the primary rehearsal date (backup Oct 13). Key commitments:
- Timebox: 2.5 hours for the live switchover (start to finish), plus a 1-hour prep window.
- Resources: Redwood will assign a named SRE and Solutions engineer for the rehearsal.
- RTO/RPO: As noted earlier, we will target <=3 min (read-only) / <=18 min (read/write) for the switchover and <=30s RPO for active token state. Evidence will include logs, KV sync timestamps, and end-to-end latency traces.
- Cost & exception: Redwood requests a signed SLA exception for limited autoscaling and temporary elevated throughput (form attached). Expected out-of-pocket is ~$2.4k for reserved capacity.

Please review the attached playbook and matrix. If this aligns, can you sign the DocuSign packet (link below) for the SLA exception and confirm the Oct 12 09:00–12:00 UTC window? We'll hold a prep call Oct 6 to finalize the load profile.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/packet/987654321
Shared drive: https://redwood-health/shared/DR_Test_Plan_v2

Thanks — looking forward to running this with your team.

Best,
Ava
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DR_Test_Plan_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: RTO_RPO_matrix.xlsx]
[Attachment: SLA_Exception_Request_Form.pdf]

From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@stellarisbank.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@stellarisbank.com, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@stellarisbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DR test schedule, RTO/RPO matrix & SLA exception follow-up

Ava — thanks, this looks good. We reviewed the matrix and confirmed the Oct 12 09:00–12:00 UTC window. Laura (ops) will complete the DocuSign for the SLA exception by EOD tomorrow. A couple of clarifying items for the prep call:
1) Can Redwood provide a pre-swivel snapshot of KV sizes and an estimate of the warm-up time expected for our session profile?
2) During the dry run, we'd like to simulate a partial-region latency increase to observe graceful degradation behavior. Is that supported in your rehearsal tooling?

If you can answer those two items in the prep call materials, we'll be set. Appreciate the thoroughness and the named SRE support.

Regards,
Laura
Director, Resilience & Ops
Stellaris Bank
